period_label: six (6) years from the date hereof
quote: In the event that the Company experiences a Change of Control (as defined below) at any time (a) on or prior to the date that is six (6) years from the date hereof, all then-unvested Warrant Shares shall automatically vest and the Warrant shall automatically be exchanged pursuant to Section 6(a), or (b) after the date that is six (6) years from the date hereof, all then-unvested Warrant Shares shall automatically be cancelled.
trigger_description: changement de contrôle de la société (fusion, cession de l'essentiel des actifs ou du capital, liquidation, procédure collective) : acquisition de toute la part non acquise dans les six ans, annulation au-delà
